portals.title: Portals
portals.description: Which state procurement portals to scrape. Each portal is checked against its robots.txt before any request is made and skipped if crawling is disallowed or the robots.txt is unreachable.

enumTitles: Iowa - State of Iowa Bid Opportunities

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional free-text filter. Sent to the portal's own search where one exists (COMMBUYS/NJSTART/OregonBuys description search, GPR title search, Iowa keyword search) and applied to the title otherwise (LaPAC). Leave empty to list every open solicitation.

postedAfter.title: Posted on or after
postedAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Solicitations with a known posted date before this day are skipped.

closesAfter.title: Closes on or after
closesAfter.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Solicitations whose close date is before this day are skipped. Defaults to today, so only solicitations that are still open are returned. Set it explicitly to include recently closed ones on portals that still list them.

maxResultsPerPortal.title: Maximum results per portal
maxResultsPerPortal.description: Stop each portal after this many solicitations. Each solicitation is one charged result. Each solicitation is one charged result. Start small; a full pull of 200 per portal with descriptions takes 10 to 20 minutes.

maxRunSeconds.title: Maximum run time (seconds)
maxRunSeconds.description: Stop cleanly and finish with the results collected so far once this many seconds have passed. 0 means no limit beyond the run timeout itself. The actor always stops about 20 seconds before the platform run timeout so the run finishes as SUCCEEDED with partial data instead of TIMED-OUT, and it splits the remaining time evenly across the selected portals.

includeDescription.title: Fetch detail pages
includeDescription.description: Fetch each solicitation's public detail page to fill description, attachments, buyer contact, NIGP/UNSPSC codes and posted date. Turn off for a faster list-only run at the same per-result price.
